messages:
taylor_g: quick follow-up from the kv-eviction postmortem. want to convert remediation items into concrete tests we can automate and own. thinking: small CI fault-injection regression, tenant-blast nightly, focused promptset for worst-case convo patterns, and an annual chaos drill. owners and rough ETA below — please call dibs or reassign.
maria_ops: +1. keep CI fast (<10m), nightly longer run (2-3h) with cost cap, promptset for evictions, and a separate tenant-isolation scenario.
devon_ml: I can take the promptset and eval harness. goal: reproduce the eviction signal we saw (long-context churn + repeated key updates). will add synthetic prompts and an eval metric pipeline. ETA: 2 sprints. filing RINF-3002.
raj_platform: I’ll own CI fault-injection and nightly tenant-blast. plan: k6 -> k8s job; tenant-blast will simulate 50 tenants, one noisy tenant that causes KV churn. need a cost shield and IRL env perms. filing RINF-3001.
sam_sre: I’ll help with the fault-injection component and monitor thresholds. propose creating a small chaoskit hook that toggles eviction probability for a controlled window. and we should add a CI canary that runs fault-injection only on main merges.
taylor_g: good. please tag all tickets with label "postmortem-eval" and link the postmortem. soft deadlines: CI regression PR by 2024-11-28, nightly tenant-blast integrated by 2024-12-20, promptset + eval by 2024-12-15, chaos drill runbook by 2025-01-15.
maria_ops: question on promptset scope 12: do we capture (a) long-context token churn, (b) prefix-heavy lookups, (c) multi-tenant noisy-client spikes, (d) hybrid long+short bursts?
devon_ml: yes to all. sample prompt description I'll add to RINF-3002 repo: 
```
PSET_A: multi-turn, 10k-16k context, repeated backward refs to hit KV lookups
PSET_B: many short 1-3 token rapid queries within same conversation id (concurrent clients)
PSET_C: tenant-mix: 49 normal tenants + 1 noisy tenant doing repeated long updates
METRICS: eviction-rate, p95-latency, quality-drop(proxies)
```
I'll set alert gates: eviction-rate delta > 10% or p95 up > 20% triggers regression failure.
raj_platform: load plan: ramp 20 -> 250 users over 10m, sustain 90m, repeat 2x. two modes: hosted-only and hosted+dedicated to validate routing/fallback. infra checklist in RINF-3001 with cost cap fields.
sam_sre: CI plan: lightweight fault injection step (30s window) that flips a feature-flag to lower KV cache size. run on PRs to main as optional canary, required on release branches. will coordinate with eng-sre for permission.
taylor_g: also add a small retro-fit: add a prober that runs at deploy time to detect immediate eviction regressions for the latest model+runtime combo before routing traffic. low-risk, short timeout.
maria_ops: scheduling a 30m sync to unblock infra creds and align testbed config: Thu 09:30 PT. invite to: @devon_ml @raj_platform @sam_sre @taylor_g @oncall-bot
oncall-bot: Calendar invite created: "Eviction test inventory handoff" Thu 09:30 PT 12 link: https://calendar.redwood/eviction-tests
devon_ml: will draft PR template for promptset PRs: include description, failure gates, and minimal repro snippet. will also add example eval thresholds: quality proxy <5% regression, p95 latency <= +15% at baseline load.
raj_platform: noted. if infra or billing blockers appear, escalate to finance + eng-sre and cc @taylor_g. I'll attach cost estimates to RINF-3001 this week.
taylor_g: summary of action tickets: RINF-3001 (tenant-blast + CI), RINF-3002 (promptset + eval harness), RINF-3003 (deploy prober + runbook), RINF-3004 (chaos drill + playbook). owners: raj_platform, devon_ml, raj_platform/sam_sre, sam_sre respectively. update tickets when PRs land.
maria_ops: thanks everyone. excited to close this loop and keep the next incident from recurring :thumbsup:
